releaseNotes:
• Guest Offline Mode Access: Use OPEN-VERSE immediately without logging in; access local AI models (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM), files, workspaces, and terminal tools in one click
• Pre-Login Update Center: Check and install in-app updates directly from the login and onboarding screen across all devices
• Universal Google OAuth Architecture: Resolved Windows URL parameter splitting and Error 400 (missing response_type); pristine RFC 8252 loopback (http://localhost:3125) and cloud bridge authorization
• Authoritative Google Account Profile: Real-time display of verified Google account name and profile picture with no-referrer CDN security bypass
• Seamless Auto-Updater Repair: Dynamic checksum verification, monotonic versionCode upgrade, and elimination of restart loop
